overview: In Odd Man Out, fifteen-year-old Andrew Whitney is living any man's dream: he's the only male in a house he shares with five beautiful women in South Beach, Florida. Unfortunately for Andrew, these women are his mom, his aunt, and his three sisters. In his 15 years of life, he's never had a correct opinion, a private phone conversation or a hot shower. His mother, Julia, a busy caterer, is a widow, which makes raising her kids even more difficult as she has to act as mother, father and family provider. His Aunt Jordan, Julia's younger sister, is a booker at a modeling agency. A single woman around thirty, Jordan has a much simpler life than Julia's but manages to make it infinitely more complicated. Andrew's older, self-consumed sister, Paige is an aspiring model. She's not only intimidating to Andrew, but to most men she comes in contact with.
title: Odd Man Out

overview: With mental health as the setting, we join actors Per and Olec on a fun journey through the fight against themselves – and their surroundings.
title: Psykodrama

overview: At the Heart of the Games, taking viewers behind the scenes of the organization of the biggest event in the world.
title: Au cœur des Jeux

overview: A satirical portrait of London adapted by Justin Cartwright from his own novel of London life.
title: Look at It This Way

overview: Jang Tae Su is a legendary criminal profiler in Korea. He was one of the first in his field and paved the way for criminal behavior analysts in the country. He has gained the absolute respect and trust within the police organization. At home, he is a single parent and raises his daughter by himself. Jang Tae Su works on a murder case and realizes that his daughter is involved in the case. The discovery shakes everything in his professional beliefs and his relationship with his daughter. To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.
title: Doubt

overview: Schiphol opens its doors for a unique look behind the scenes of the largest airport in the Netherlands. Passion and dedication are central to this series and everything revolves around the safe and efficient flow of passenger traffic.
title: Schiphol Airport

overview: Around ten high school students studying theatre see a replacement teacher arrive for a month. As they declaim Shakespeare while keeping their distance, the teacher cuts the rehearsal short. At the heart of an age where we often advance masked, our gaze too high or our heads too lowered, the question of the intimate imposes itself on them.
title: Ceux qui rougissent

overview: Minase Jin, a top student who is indifferent to others, has been living his school life avoiding any interaction with Hirukawa Haruki, a reckless troublemaker in their class. However, one day, Minase accidentally witnesses Hirukawa outside of school, covered in bruises after being beaten by his father. Unintentionally learning this secret, Minase tries to distance himself, not wanting to get involved any further. But he can't get the image of the Hirukawa he saw, so different from the one at school, out of his mind…As the two begin to discover sides of each other that they never saw at school, new feelings start to blossom, feelings that neither of them had ever experienced before.
title: Miseinen ~Mijukuna Oretachi wa Bukiyo ni Shinkochu~

overview: Black comedies looking at a 'sinking' Britain in the 80s.
title: Tickets for the Titanic

overview: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking invites fans to mix, whisk and glaze their way to success, with professional pastry chefs competing against each other to create enchanting sweet treats, themed around the Harry Potter stories. Will the bakers be able to channel their inner Mrs Weasley? Or will their attempts be as successful as one of Seamus Finnigan's exploding cauldrons?
title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking

overview: Brother's Keeper is a television series that aired from 1998 to 1999 on ABC. This sitcom was about Porter Waide (William Ragsdale), a single father who raises his son, Oscar (Justin Cooper). At the same time, though, he must keep his brother, Bobby (Sean O'Bryan), out of trouble.
title: Brother's Keeper

overview: Evidence of an impending attack in Hamburg puts the police authorities on alert. The focus is on the aging LKA man Gabriel Bach and the young BKA officer Holly Valentin. Out of necessity, they recruit the Afghan substitute teacher Raza Shaheen as an informant, who has previously had absolutely nothing to do with terrorism or organized crime. Under enormous time pressure, they work to save lives in the midst of a maelstrom of fear, prejudice and hysteria - and in doing so put themselves in great danger.
title: Informant – Angst über der Stadt

overview: Como Agua para Chocolate explores the idea that sometimes traditions can become a prison, an obstacle for love. Tita de la Garza and Pedro Múzquiz are two souls deeply in love, yet unable to be together due to entrenched family customs. The protagonists navigate a world of magical realism and rich flavors as Tita struggles between the destiny imposed on her by her family and her fight for love. Along the way, the audience will witness her greatest refuge: the kitchen. For Tita, her magical connection to cooking becomes an active resistance against oppression, allowing her to channel her deepest desires and passions into her recipes, transforming those who taste them.
title: Como Agua para Chocolate

overview: Lost Monster Files features a team of experts who gained exclusive access to Sanderson's detailed research and will use it to reinvestigate his most prominent unfinished cases. The team will focus on present day sightings such as the Abominable Snowman and Chupacabra to determine if modern science and technology can bring them closer to answers for these mysterious creatures.
title: Lost Monster Files

overview: Six individual plays for children.
title: Theatre Box

overview: Cheng Yu, a kept woman with a rebellious spirit, struggles to break free from Zhou Jin's control. In a staged "infidelity incident," she meets Pei Zheng, a "male model." Cheng Yu repeatedly provokes Pei Zheng, giving him opportunities to "rescue" her. From feigned indifference to calculated advances, the two initially use each other but gradually develop genuine feelings.
title: Bait Hook

overview: The story follows Ling Chuxia, a young girl trapped in a difficult situation, who bravely defies family constraints and societal criticism. She forms a bond with the male lead, Liang Junye, who shares her struggles. Together, they support each other, overcome their life challenges, and join forces to uncover an evil conspiracy by a foreign tribe, ultimately protecting their homeland.
title: The Unbreakable Bond

overview: Told from multiple points of view, as a means to explore issues of perspective, bias, and trauma, this compelling drama is inspired by the disturbing stories surrounding a Midwestern couple who adopts a girl with a rare form of dwarfism. But as they begin to raise her alongside their three biological children, mystery emerges around her age and background, and they slowly start to suspect she may not be who she says she is. As they defend their family from the daughter they've grown to believe is a threat, she fights her own battle to confront her past and what her future holds, in a showdown that ultimately plays out in the tabloids and the courtroom.
title: Good American Family

overview: Two of a Kind follows the hi-jinks that ensue when a widowed college professor hires an attractive 26 year old student to babysit his precocious 12 year old twin girls.
title: Two of a Kind

overview: Set within the unique landscapes of Australia, this series uncovers the remarkable blend of architectural ingenuity and luxurious design that characterises Australian homes.
title: Dream Homes Revealed
Ninja Warrior, le parcours des héros

overview: Cuffy is an impulsive doer of mischief, but something of a saint among the scoundrels in the tinkering fraternity.
title: Cuffy

overview: After 10 years of exile, Anna Brodeur is back in the lives of her loved ones, and finds reconnecting with her past a real challenge.
title: Le Retour d'Anna Brodeur
Ninja Warrior : Le Choc des Nations

overview: Komori Hiroto is a kind young man who works at the city hall. Since losing his parents in an accident, he has been living with his younger brother Michito, who has autism spectrum disorder. Their restful days are changed when they meet a young boy called "Lion" who they decide to take in. Before long, they get caught up in an incident that changes their lives completely.
title: Light of My Lion

overview: You Wish is an American fantasy sitcom that started as part of ABC's TGIF programming on Friday nights for the fall of 1997, along with Sabrina, the Teenage Witch, Boy Meets World, and Teen Angel. You Wish was considered a 1990s version of I Dream of Jeannie. In this situation, a genie lives with a family, instead of a single man. In the show's pilot episode, Gillian Apple and her two children visit a rug shop where they buy a rug, unexpectedly releasing a genie who has been imprisoned for 2,000 years.
title: You Wish

overview: The youngest forensic doctor in Licheng, Qi Sizhe, loses his girlfriend, Yu Fei, in a car accident. However, he soon uncovers a mysterious force behind the crash. Determined to find the truth, he joins the criminal investigation team in Hecheng, only to be caught in a series of bizarre, chilling cases. Victims long dead are wrapped in webs, and missing bodies appear preserved in formalin in the morgue. As he teams up with Zhu Qingyue and Han Feng, they break case after case. And the truth behind Yu Fei's death and the "Original Diamond" drug case begins to surface…
title: The Truth Within

overview: Comedy series in which Ernest Springer dies after being hit by a champagne cork and finds himself in the British section of heaven.
title: Dead Ernest

overview: The British consul in a Latin American banana republic gets its first female Consul-General.
title: Farrington of the F.O.

overview: Three ageing GPs are horrified to discover they are being replaced with sexy young female doctors.
title: Doctors' Daughters

overview: Emily Lane is a good-natured Christmas shop owner with a secret past. When local murders begin to pop up in Fletcher's Grove, Emily can't help but to use her unique talents from her past life to help solve murders that affect people in her new life. She crosses paths with Detective Sam Wilner who she starts to make a connection with, until he comes to learn there is more to Emily than meets the eye.
title: Mistletoe Murders

overview: The pain and disappointment of love drives Rain and Love into each other's orbits. With the assistance of Dean and Pat, Love and Rain are able to get over the barrier erected by Rain's painful past.
title: Unlock Your Love

overview: It's the official Married at First Sight UK podcast! Join us as we dissect all the drama and debate the juiciest goings-on.
title: MAFS UK: It's Official! With Chloe Burrows

overview: Teen Angel is an American fantasy sitcom that aired during ABC's TGIF Friday night lineup from 1997 to 1998. The series was created by The Simpsons writers/producers Al Jean and Mike Reiss. Teen Angel follows a high school boy, Steve Beauchamp (Corbin Allred), and his recently deceased best friend, Marty DePolo (Mike Damus), who dies from eating a six-month-old hamburger from under Steve's bed on a dare and is then sent back to Earth as Steve's guardian angel. Marty's guide is a large, orange and disembodied head named Rod (Ron Glass), who identifies as God's cousin (a running gag throughout the series is that Rod is mistaken for God himself). Maureen McCormick, who played Steve's mother, Judy, left the series halfway through its run. Marty, as a supernatural being, would frequently break the fourth wall; for instance, prior to the opening credits of the episode "Grumpy Young Men", Marty explained the absence of Steve's mother and the return of his father to the viewers.
title: Teen Angel

overview: Masha, a girl from a simple family, studies at a prestigious university in the capital. And although she does not fit into the world of "golden youth", her best friend Dimka is one of them. When a student from England named Roman transfers to their group, this not only challenges Masha and Dimka's friendship, but also sets off a chain of events that will change the lives of many people forever.
title: Многогранники

overview: An unknown narrator stumbled upon a voice recorder and audio tapes in a bunker. Apparently, they were made a year and a half after the epidemic began. The virus affected the part of the brain responsible for sleep in the survivors. People lost the ability to wake up on their own. Those who slept for more than three hours did not wake up. The recordings were made over the course of a week by a man named Zhenya. The narrator believes that listening to these tapes may be useful to someone. In the recordings, Zhenya records his daily state. He communicates with the outside world using a radio station. Zhenya settled in the bunker of the bandits he killed. He is wounded and doubts that he will last long.
title: Выжившие. Радио «Неделька»

overview: A unique look at one of the oldest professions and cultures in the world. An observer-director travels with the circus, revealing to the viewer the joys, sorrows, adventures and realities of the sometimes harsh and sometimes touching life of a vagabond.
title: Шелковый путь

overview: Recently divorced Laura Kingsley arrives home after ten years in California to find her beloved Britain much changed.
title: Laura and Disorder

overview: NITV Sport presents the 2024 Pro Bull Riding series from across regional and metro Australia. Join us as this country's toughest cowboys compete to be named the 2024 National PBR champion.
title: Pro Bull Riding Australia 2024

overview: Upmarket wine merchants Mowbray & Crofts find times getting harder as a recession bites: the owners are forced to meet something called 'work'.
title: Ffizz

overview: The hugely successful British television series Father Dear Father is transplanted to Australia when novelist Patrick Glover and his assistant Nanny trek down under to write the great Australian crime novel, and end up supervising Patricks boisterous young nieces while their own father is abroad.While Liz and Sue must learn to understand their conservative Uncle, Patrick must also adjust to a new life in Australia, with hilarious consequences.
title: Father, Dear Father in Australia

overview: It's the new millennium and music is facing an existential threat: illegal piracy. In Red Flag: Music's Failed RevolutionWalkley Award-winning journalist Marc Fennell (The Kingdom, Framed, The Mission) uncovers the bizarre story of the Aussie start up, Guvera, that promised to revolutionise music forever, but instead vanished in a $180 million mystery. The two-part blackly comic docuseries premieres at 8.35pm Tuesday, 15 October on SBS and SBS On Demand. Through exclusive interviews, never-before seen footage and photographs, incredible archive and dramatic reenactments, Red Flag: Music's Failed Revolution charts the spectacular rise and fall of Guvera – the Gold Coast tech start-up that challenged Spotify and was nicknamed the "iTunes Killer"- which once had A-list superstars like Alice Cooper and Mos Def lining up behind it with one mission: to destroy internet piracy. In the 2 x 1 hour docuseries, Marc is joined by iconic Australian musician Ben Lee as they take a nostalgic trip to the 90s, the golden age, before piracy threatened to take down the multi-billion-dollar music industry and an unlikely saviour. Guvera, emerged from the Gold Coast. With an audacious plan to revolutionise the music industry by promising free, legal mp3 downloads (and later streaming), Guvera's colourful founders offered a beacon of hope in an era dominated by illegal file sharing platforms like Napster and Pirate Bay. In a few short years, Guvera would take the world by storm – becoming the main player in the music downloading and streaming market and beating Spotify to launch in key markets. With its superstar following, glitzy parties and lucrative brand sponsorships, including Harley Davidson and The Australian Open, it raised an eye watering $180 million, but what was really going on behind closed doors? As Marc digs deeper, red flags start to emerge, uncovering a web of shady business dealings, ethical question marks, a company on the brink, and many lives left in its wake. With candid interviews with former Guvera staff, devastated investors, music industry experts, and behind the scenes footage, the documentary delves into the darker side of the start-up and a "fake-it-till-you-make-it" story so familiar with other famous tech start-ups, fuelled by the unwavering belief that one big idea can change the world.
title: Red Flag: Music's Failed Revolution

overview: What'Cha Got profiles sports and entertainment personalities and their automotive character.
title: What'Cha Got

overview: Akari Shinno s a detective with a special ability. She is able to see the eight human emotions in color. Due to a case, she teams up with Detective Ryo Kazehaya. They work together to reveal the truth behind heinous crimes.
title: Okutô kanjô sôsakan Shinno Akari

overview: Until very recently, Terry Prince was a conduit joint insulation mechanic in the Midlands; he and wife Viv lived with his parents, and football was simply a game he enjoyed playing for the local team. But Terry's natural talent has come the attention of big-league manager Harry Turnbull, and he and Viv now find themselves trying to come to terms with a variety of novel tactics... both on and off the field!
title: Feet First

overview: Basil Bulstrode is pompous, grouchy and stubborn - he's also an undertaker who loves his work.
title: That's Your Funeral

overview: Art Detectives is a compelling new original crime series centered around the Heritage Crime Unit, a police department consisting of art loving DI Mick Palmer and straight-talking DC Shazia Malik. Together, they solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings, to Banksy street art, medieval manuscripts and collectible vinyl. Throughout the season, the artfully astute detectives encounter a fake Vermeer, Viking gold, a rare Chinese vase and items rescued from the Titanic. It's a rich and colorful world driven by greed, obsession, lust and revenge. Mick navigates these demanding cases while managing a budding romance with museum curator Rosa and the sudden reappearance of his charismatic father, Ron, who just happens to be one of Britain's most notorious forgers.
title: Art Detectives

overview: Many years ago, a tragedy occurred in Vera's family - an unknown person kidnapped her little daughter Katya and demanded a ransom, but had no intention of returning the baby alive. Since then, the woman has not been able to recover - she celebrates her daughter's birthday every year, and even created a photo with the help of artificial intelligence of what Katya would look like now, at 18 years old. Pyotr, Vera's husband, considers all this a meaningless ritual, and for a long time now he and his wife have only been connected by their common business. Despite everything, Vera hopes for a miracle that will return her Katya, and suddenly she sees a girl on the street who seems to have stepped out of that very photo.
title: Вера

overview: The series brings together encounters in daily life that are considered "too much" with different guests.
title: Karşılaşmalar

overview: About 20 years before Clanul, Bebe Udrea (George Mihaita), aka "Macelaru" (The Butcher), aimed to build his own clan and rise to the top of the mafia. The series reveals his dangerous journey and the origins of beloved Clanul characters.
title: Tătuțu

overview: Катя Соколова — врач-реаниматолог больницы. Впереди у нее долгожданная свадьба и рождение ребенка. Но однажды ее будущему угрожает несчастный случай. Вернувшись домой, Катя вступается за девушку, которую избивает мужчина, и сама получает травму. Она теряет ребенка, жених отменяет свадьбу и уезжает. Катя пишет заявление в полицию, но дело затягивается. Спустя год @Катя влюбляется в бизнесмена Михаила Власова. Кажется, она наконец-то нашла свое предназначение... Михаил знакомит Катю со своей семьей — отцом и младшим братом Иваном, в котором Катя узнает человека, искалечившего ее жизнь. Теперь Катя намерена довести начатое до конца и добиться справедливости, чего бы это ей ни стоило.
title: Выбор сердца

overview: Dasha, Katya and Lidia Petrovna are completely unknown women. They are united only by a recently deceased businessman – father, husband and son. After his death, the women turn out to be heirs to a common cause and common debts. Now three women, different in character, age and social status, who also can't stand each other, are forced to unite.
title: Три любимые женщины

overview: Making a Murderer chronicles the story of Steven Avery, who spent 18 years in prison for rape and was freed after DNA linked another man to the crime. His release triggered major criminal justice reform legislation, and he filed a lawsuit that threatened to expose corruption in local law enforcement and award him millions of dollars. But in the midst of the civil case, he became the prime suspect in a murder, for which he was convicted and sentenced to life in prison. Making A Murderer examines allegations of police and prosecutorial misconduct, evidence tampering and witness coercion. The series looks at what went wrong in the first case and questions whether scientific advances and legislative reforms over the past three decades have gotten us any closer to delivering truth and justice in the system.
title: Making a Murderer

overview: Marina has been married to Gosha for 14 years, they got married right after graduation. Recently, there has been a crisis in their relationship: it was not the first time Marina had a miscarriage at an early stage, Gosha threw himself into work. Marina began to wonder if such a family life was suitable for her... Moreover, before her eyes is the example of her older sister Lyuba, whose personal life was a success. Soon the news comes that Lyuba has died. Marina can't believe the accident. She finds her sister's childhood diary and in it notes made recently. It turns out that the exemplary Lyuba was unhappy and lonely for a long time. What happened to my sister? Who is to blame for her death? Marina decides to conduct her own investigation.
title: Тайный дневник моей сестры

overview: Successful lawyer Anna Kalinina is going to marry designer Nikita, with whom she is expecting a child. But literally on the threshold of the registry office, the groom leaves her, exchanging her for another. Anya plunges headlong into her work, and suddenly she gets the case ... of her ex, who is accused of murdering a nanny in the house of businessman Alexander Sobolev. Nikita's mother begs Anna to help her son, because he is the father of her child. Convinced of Nikita's innocence, Anna goes to the village where the crime was committed and meets Sobolev and his little daughter Katya. At first, the relationship between Anna and Sobolev does not work out, the businessman is not eager to help the criminal's lawyer. But still they manage to get on the trail of the real culprit of what happened. Gradually, sympathy arises between Sobolev and Anna, which develops into a serious feeling…
title: Адвокат для сбежавшего жениха

overview: The series "Blondes" will tell about the work of a secret special department for solving especially complex crimes in St. Petersburg. The agents have an extremely unusual cover - their office exists under the guise of the "Blondes" marriage agency. The department is supervised by an experienced investigator Smolov, who has gathered three completely different girls under his wing. This is a former employee of the Investigative Committee - rational Kiseleva, a bright and daring lover of horoscopes and men Gorskaya and uncompromising Boyko, a master of martial arts. Together they will have to not only catch offenders, but also learn to work in a team.
title: Блонды

overview: By showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and graduation, it asks about the true meaning of 'happiness'. A delightful family drama that will resonate and laughter across all generations.
title: My Merry Marriage

overview: Clutch: The NBA Playoffs offers an in-depth look at the 2024 NBA Playoffs, where the league's brightest stars and most determined veterans battle for supremacy. The series delves into the high-stakes action both on and off the court, chronicling the personal and professional journeys of players like Zion Williamson, Tyrese Maxey, Jalen Brunson, Tyrese Haliburton, P.J. Washington, and Jaylen Brown as they navigate the challenges of postseason basketball. With exclusive access, Clutch captures defining moments that shape not just games, but legacies showcasing the NBA's next generation of leaders.
title: Clutch: The NBA Playoffs

overview: Politics, tragedy and conquest combine in stories behind the building of Australia. The Bridge, Pipe Dreams and A Wire Through the Heart combine rare archival images with dramatic storytelling in showcasing three landmark events that would allow Australia to mark its place in the world. The Sydney Harbour Bridge, the Kalgoorlie Pipeline and the Overland Telegraph line were engineering triumphs, but the human drama in constructing Australia is even more fascinating.
title: Constructing Australia

overview: Reverend Eric Camden and his wife Annie have always had their hands full caring for seven children, not to mention the friends, sweethearts and spouses that continually come and go in the Camden household. This year, Eric and Annie will find their family back together in Glenoak with the return of Matt and Simon. As is often the case when the house is overflowing with Camdens, Eric and Annie are in for a bumpy ride as their children take landmark steps in their lives. Meanwhile, Eric and Annie continue their journey as soul mates, parents and grandparents whose love and respect for each other brings them ever closer. Through all the ups and downs, Eric and Annie have managed to keep their romance alive and their family together. Not only are they raising their own seven children, they've picked up several additional family members along the way.
title: 7th Heaven

overview: The College Football Playoff: Top 25 is a weekly sports talk show that began in October 2014 because the BCS (Bowl Championship Selection committee) no longer existed. A new committee was then formed to decide the best Top 25 NCAA football teams in the Nation. Based on a very complicated system of points the Top 4 teams at the end of the regular college football season would be required to play each other in a playoff to determine the best team in the Nation which would be the last team standing. This show beginning every October will announce the Top 25 teams each week and then the College Football analysts and experts will discuss that week's poll results.
title: College Football Playoff: Top 25

overview: Jake Makes It Easy provides viewers a step-by-step process for creating a main course and dessert that incorporate aspects from classic dishes and unique flavors all while keeping it simple. Having worked in some of New York City's top restaurants and test kitchens, Jake brings his impressive culinary background and love of hosting to create inspired meals fit for any table. With dishes including everything from balsamic and soy brisket, challah monkey bread, and Iraqi salmon to date brownies, baked gnocchi and soup-less chicken soup, Jake weaves together his heritage and stories of food and family to create unforgettable meals every guest will love.
title: Jake Makes It Easy

overview: Sitcom set in a quiet fire station which serves a small community with its 60-year-old fire engine Bessie.
title: Fire Crackers

overview: Perfect combination of breaking news, current affairs and popular culture trends.
title: La Voz de la Mañana

overview: In an effort to bolster their pockets, Squire Haggard and his unscrupulous son, Roderick strut across the English countryside desperately searching for an heiress willing to part with her money, a man whose talent at the gambling table does not match his view of himself, or any manner of other scheme that may amuse and offer financial recompense for as little effort as is possible.
title: Haggard

overview: Reggaeton: The Sound that Conquered the World dives into the genre's origins to becoming a cultural and commercial powerhouse in the global music industry through the eyes of pivotal Reggaeton figures.
title: Reggaeton: The Sound that Conquered the World

overview: This instructional series teaches new routines, exercises, and styles. Whether it's yoga, weight training, aerobics, or martial arts, the objective is to tone and tighten.
title: All Star Workouts

overview: The mixed fortunes of an extended family of music-hall entertainers in search of their big break.
title: Funny Man

overview: The dogmatic Lord Rustless finds his stately posture frustrated by his uncontrollable staff as he attempts to lecture on a series of topics.
title: Hark at Barker

overview: Ron Archer and son Trevor set out to buy and rennovate the more-than-a-little dilapidated pier at Midbourne.
title: High & Dry

overview: Deal or No Deal? That's the £250,000 question (if the contestant is lucky) posed by presenter Noel Edmonds. There are 22 players, each of whom holds one of 22 sealed boxes, each containing a different amount of money, ranging from 1p to £250,000. One contestant is chosen to play the game and he or she opens the other 21 boxes by choosing one at a time. When a box is opened, the value contained in that box is taken off the board and cannot be won. At the end of each round (a maximum of six), the contestant is made an offer by the Banker to buy the contestant's case. If the player accepts the offer, he or she wins that amount. If the offer is declined, the contestant continues choosing boxes in the subsequent rounds. The game ends when the contestant accepts the Banker's offer or ends up with just one box remaining (in addition to the contestant's box). At that point, the contestant must choose between their box or the other box. The contestant wins the amount in the chosen box.
title: Deal or No Deal

overview: The girl Xian was raised by Hui, a single mother who runs a photo studio. By chance, Xian followed her lover Cong to the studio, which attracted the attention of boss Meng of the film company, and her life's destiny changed. Boss Meng took advantage of Xian's purity and yearning for an actor's identity to give her the glory of a star and emotional dreams. Later, in order to protect himself during the war, he abandoned Xian, who was already pregnant. Mother Hui also passed away sadly because she could not bear the betrayal of her emotional support Lao Wang. The nostalgia for her daughter Zhi has become Xian's only hope for survival. Time flies, Zhi has grown up, and she falls in love with her classmate Zou Jie, who also works in the shipyard. Due to their background, the love of this young couple was hindered. However, the two people who pursued progress still walked firmly together. Xian, who has reached middle age, reunites with her long-lost former lover Cong, and they renew their relationship and love each other for the rest of their lives. The life situation full of joys and sorrows finally cleared up all the misunderstandings caused by the collision of ideas between the two generations, and the mother and daughter ushered in their own beautiful lives together.
title: Blossoms in Dream

overview: On a rainy night, Sun tries to sell umbrellas at a bus stop, where he meets Dol, an office worker who seems to be uninterested in him. But this doesn't stop Sun from pursuing Dol, and eventually Sun learns of Dol's secret. Will these two come together despite their differences and become soulmates?
title: Every You, Every Me

overview: Yang Zi Xiang is sent to Taiwan for business negotiations but gets attacked. He hires Jiang Shao Peng to take care of him and takes this opportunity to escape from his family responsibility while also falling for Shao Peng. Zi Xiang's assistant, Feng Jie, acts as a stand-in for his boss, and Xin Jia, the assassin hired to get rid of Zi Xiang, repeatedly fails to take out his target. While Feng Jie manages to escape, sparks of love start to bloom.
title: See Your Love

overview: When international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways, two FBI agents are sent to Paris, Venice, Rome and New York to uncover the truth behind these deaths and end up discovering a conspiracy that threatens the future of humanity.
title: The Beauty

overview: A difficult period is coming in the relationship between architects Nadezhda and Andrey – financial instability, work problems, Andrey's sick mother, whose care requires money, as well as unsuccessful attempts to have a child. Adding fuel to the fire is the arrival of their successful classmate Kirill, Nadia's ex-boyfriend, who comes to their town to build a large shopping center. Kirill makes a tempting offer to the couple: Nadia – to head the company leading the construction, and Andrey – to become the chief designer of his project. They agree, unaware that Kirill has a plan for them: he is going to take revenge on Nadia, who 15 years ago chose another.
title: Забытая любовь

overview: "On the Edge" is a show that will definitely make you want to delve deeper into science. Host Yulia Gavrilina and her co-host Dima Pobedinsky will conduct shocking experiments and demonstrate how the laws of physics work.
title: На грани

overview: Crimewatch Caught is set to reveal the inner workings of how detectives investigated and solved a range of complex crimes. Each episode will feature exclusive interviews with leading officers, alongside the crucial CCTV, forensic evidence and witness testimony that allowed them to bring the perpetrators to justice.
title: Crimewatch Caught

overview: A group of candidates who are terrible drivers will be tested. They hand in there driver's license and they got to prove in this program that they can improve their driving style to get it back. The last candidate which remains is called the Worst Driver and gets a trophy.
title: De Slechtste Chauffeur van Nederland

overview: Dex is a 9-year-old artist, explorer, and ‘paleontologist in training'. Like Dan, Trek, and Dana before him, Dex uses his Dino Field Guide to magically see and study dinosaurs in the real world. But Dex envisions them a little differently. Thanks to his artistic eye, Dex wants to reconsider how dinosaurs looked and lived and he's not afraid to get right into the action to do it. Fortunately, he's got his geology-loving neighbor Kayla along for this prehistoric ride. Join Dex and Kayla as they re-examine and question everything we thought we knew about dinosaurs.
title: Dino Dex

overview: Isabel Eriksson was drugged and kidnapped - and then locked in a bunker. A terrifying incident that has plagued and haunted her for almost ten years. In the documentary Bunkerkvinnan, she tells her story.
title: Bunkerkvinnan

overview: When Li Zhiren was waiting for his girlfriend Zhang Lulu, he was attracted by a mysterious girl named Chen Yueran. He was shocked to find that she was the representative of his partner and was gradually entering his life. However, the truth was more astonishing. Chen Yueran was his dead ex-wife who came back in a different name only for revenge. She managed to reveal Zhang Lulu's secrets step by step and turned her against Li Zhiren. In the end, they worked together to send Li Zhiren to jail. In the meantime, Chen Yueran and a forceful man Gao Lingyu started to have feelings for each other. A game of revenge and love has begun.
title: Veil of Revenge

overview: Swarms – whether insects, animals, birds, or even humans – are powerful and complex coordinated actions between individuals, working together to benefit the community. Some see a higher intelligence in a swarm, while others doubt the wisdom of crowds. Swarm behaviour has even been equated with herd stupidity. In this two-part documentary, internationally renowned scientists and experts from diverse research fields dispel prejudices and show the intelligence of swarms. Using fascinating high-speed recordings and thermal images of various natural swarms, the researchers attempt to break down swarm codes, explain strange collective behaviour, and explore how we can learn from nature to bring about astounding technological advances. This series aims to help viewers understand the intelli- gence and organised chaos of swarms, even as they are mesmerised by the swarms' astonishing beauty.
title: Schlaue Schwärme

overview: Known as 'The Angel of Death' Beverley Allitt was responsible for the murder of 4 children, attempted murder of 3 more and grievous bodily harm of 6 others, all whilst employed in the role of a nurse on a children's ward in Lincolnshire. A Nurse is the last person you'd expect to turn out to be a serial killer.
title: The Killer Nurse

overview: Explore the intense and sometimes deadly relationship between twins. How does a closeness generally seen as positive thing turn into something much darker?
title: Twisted Twins
